svg.title: GrimGlow Issue 6 — Page 13 — "Centuries Before Us" — Section 3 opens
svg.desc: Page 13: 4 panels in 3 tiers (banner / tall-half + tall-half / full-bottom-tall). Section 3 reframes the basement at FAIRY SCALE — Luma alone in vast stone cathedral, scanner cone the only light. Trail of four-inch footprints in centuries-old dust. Far wall reveals five claw gouges with amber-black bio-trace fluorescing. HUD confirms cross-ref match with Issue 4 sample. Composure cracks. Then scanner sweep catches first carved lines of fairy glyph on adjacent wall — fluorescing BLUE-WHITE, the answering color. Two civilizations left evidence in the same basement.
